minor.issue: Cloudflare/ingress in front of preview URL replaces the origin's Cache-Control ('public, max-age=86400' OR 'private, no-store') with a blanket 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on egress. Origin sets the correct headers (verified via curl http://localhost:8001) — this is a CDN/ingress policy, not an app bug. Result: SEC-003 goal (never cache private/restricted files in shared caches) IS met (arguably over-met); side effect: public avatars/hero images cannot be edge-cached at CDN, adding origin roundtrip cost. Consider a CDN-side rule that respects origin Cache-Control on /api/files/*.

action_items: NON-BLOCKING: If public-file CDN caching is desired, whitelist origin Cache-Control on /api/files/* in the Cloudflare/ingress config; the origin already sets both variants correctly.
NON-BLOCKING: Consider explicit constants for the two Cache-Control strings in server.py:778 to prevent typo drift (e.g. `CC_PUBLIC = 'public, max-age=86400'`, `CC_PRIVATE = 'private, no-store'`).

NON-BLOCKING: /api/bookings/{id}/confirm-mock env-gate check runs at request time; consider also refusing to register the route entirely when ENABLE_MOCK_CONFIRM=false so it becomes a 404 (route not found) instead of a 410 — hides the very existence of the mock endpoint in prod.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:160-173 — _client_ip correctly returns parts[-1] (rightmost) from X-Forwarded-For, falling back to X-Real-IP then request.client.host. Comment explicitly documents the Kubernetes-ingress append semantics. Good.

server.py:640 — signup rejects role not in ('parent','tutor') → 400 'Invalid role'. Good. FYI Pydantic model doesn't restrict `role` via a Literal type; enforcement is only in the handler. Consider `role: Literal['parent','tutor']` on SignupRequest for defense-in-depth so garbage roles return 422 from validation before reaching the check.

server.py:727-779 — /api/files/{path}: private-file (child avatar) requires owner OR admin (401 anon, 403 wrong-user); restricted-file (accreditation via photo_url/document_url/urls[]) requires ANY authenticated caller (401 anon); public otherwise. Cache-Control conditional on is_private|is_restricted correctly routes to 'private, no-store' vs 'public, max-age=86400'. Verified end-to-end against origin.

server.py:851 — `needle = re.escape(q.strip())[:80]` — correct order (escape first, then truncate). Slicing after re.escape could theoretically split a multi-byte escape sequence but re.escape only emits ASCII backslash-escapes, so this is safe.

server.py:1095-1114 — confirm-mock reads os.getenv('ENABLE_MOCK_CONFIRM','true').lower() on every request (not cached at import), so a .env swap + backend restart is enough to flip behavior. Default 'true' preserves dev-flow. Message 'Mock payment confirmation is disabled in this environment.' — good, doesn't leak implementation details.

Cache-Control tests MUST hit ORIGIN_URL='http://localhost:8001' — the Cloudflare edge rewrites Cache-Control on egress, so hitting the public preview URL will see 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' regardless of what the origin sets. Between session-9 and session-8-fernet run `sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 12` to clear rate-limit buckets, otherwise session-8's admin login can 429. rca_of_issue: No open functional bugs — all Session-9 fixes verified. One environmental observation worth flagging for prod ops: the CDN in front of the preview URL globally rewrites Cache-Control to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. For SEC-003 this HAPPENS to be safe (still uncached in shared caches, which is the requirement) but silently defeats the 'public, max-age=86400' optimization the origin sets for genuinely public files. If the same CDN policy exists in production, public tutor avatars / hero images will always miss CDN and hit origin. Fix: whitelist Cache-Control passthrough on the /api/files/* path prefix at Cloudflare, or set a CDN cache rule keyed on the response's origin Cache-Control. Not blocking for the security review; blocking for cost/perf if the same policy is deployed.
